o.text: Borrowed from Russian балл (ball), from French balle (“voting ball”).
Borrowed from Russian бал (bal), from French bal, from Late Latin ballō.
Borrowed from Russian антра́кт (antrákt), from French entr'acte.

*süləmək + -n. From Proto-Turkic *sü-le- (“to have an expedition”), ultimately from Proto-Common Turkic *sǖ (“army”). Exhibits semantic development as in: to have an expedition by oneself > to prowl, to scour.
Derivating from Proto-Common Turkic *sil(e) (“saliva”) via a semantic development as in: wandering for food < saliva from hunger < saliva is unlikely.
